name: name
description: Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix

name: placement_tenancy
description: The tenancy of the instance. Valid values are 'default' or 'dedicated'

name: max_size
description: The maximum size of the auto scale group

name: wait_for_elb_capacity
description: Setting this will cause Terraform to wait for exactly this number of healthy instances in all attached load balancers on both create and update operations. Takes precedence over min_elb_capacity behavior.

name: image_id
description: The EC2 image ID to launch

name: iam_instance_profile
description: The IAM instance profile to associate with launched instances

name: default_cooldown
description: The amount of time, in seconds, after a scaling activity completes before another scaling activity can start

name: target_group_arns
description: A list of aws_alb_target_group ARNs, for use with Application Load Balancing

name: suspended_processes
description: A list of processes to suspend for the AutoScaling Group. The allowed values are Launch, Terminate, HealthCheck, ReplaceUnhealthy, AZRebalance, AlarmNotification, ScheduledActions, AddToLoadBalancer. Note that if you suspend either the Launch or Terminate process types, it can prevent your autoscaling group from functioning properly.

name: protect_from_scale_in
description: Allows setting instance protection. The autoscaling group will not select instances with this setting for terminination during scale in events.

name: instance_type
description: The size of instance to launch

name: ephemeral_block_device
description: Customize Ephemeral (also known as 'Instance Store') volumes on the instance

name: min_elb_capacity
description: Setting this causes Terraform to wait for this number of instances to show up healthy in the ELB only on creation. Updates will not wait on ELB instance number changes

name: enable_monitoring
description: Enables/disables detailed monitoring. This is enabled by default.

name: tags_as_map
description: A map of tags and values in the same format as other resources accept.  This will be zipmapped into the non-standard format that the aws_autoscaling_group requires.

name: wait_for_capacity_timeout
description: A maximum duration that Terraform should wait for ASG instances to be healthy before timing out. (See also Waiting for Capacity below.) Setting this to '0' causes Terraform to skip all Capacity Waiting behavior.

name: lc_name
description: Creates a unique name for launch configuration beginning with the specified prefix

name: asg_name
description: Creates a unique name for autoscaling group beginning with the specified prefix

name: launch_configuration
description: The name of the launch configuration to use (if it is created outside of this module)

name: security_groups
description: A list of security group IDs to assign to the launch configuration

name: ebs_block_device
description: Additional EBS block devices to attach to the instance

name: min_size
description: The minimum size of the auto scale group

name: vpc_zone_identifier
description: A list of subnet IDs to launch resources in

name: force_delete
description: Allows deleting the autoscaling group without waiting for all instances in the pool to terminate. You can force an autoscaling group to delete even if it's in the process of scaling a resource. Normally, Terraform drains all the instances before deleting the group. This bypasses that behavior and potentially leaves resources dangling

name: create_asg
description: Whether to create autoscaling group

name: key_name
description: The key name that should be used for the instance

name: associate_public_ip_address
description: Associate a public ip address with an instance in a VPC

name: ebs_optimized
description: If true, the launched EC2 instance will be EBS-optimized

name: desired_capacity
description: The number of Amazon EC2 instances that should be running in the group

name: placement_group
description: The name of the placement group into which you'll launch your instances, if any

name: metrics_granularity
description: The granularity to associate with the metrics to collect. The only valid value is 1Minute

name: enabled_metrics
description: A list of metrics to collect. The allowed values are GroupMinSize, GroupMaxSize, GroupDesiredCapacity, GroupInServiceInstances, GroupPendingInstances, GroupStandbyInstances, GroupTerminatingInstances, GroupTotalInstances

name: create_lc
description: Whether to create launch configuration

name: user_data
description: The user data to provide when launching the instance

name: spot_price
description: The price to use for reserving spot instances

name: load_balancers
description: A list of elastic load balancer names to add to the autoscaling group names

name: tags
description: A list of tag blocks. Each element should have keys named key, value, and propagate_at_launch.

name: root_block_device
description: Customize details about the root block device of the instance

name: health_check_grace_period
description: Time (in seconds) after instance comes into service before checking health

name: health_check_type
description: Controls how health checking is done. Values are - EC2 and ELB

name: termination_policies
description: A list of policies to decide how the instances in the auto scale group should be terminated. The allowed values are OldestInstance, NewestInstance, OldestLaunchConfiguration, ClosestToNextInstanceHour, Default
